description: Use a one-shot token chain to delay arbitration enable and anti-backdrive device turn-on until a minimum startup packet has definitely landed, suppressing UVLO chatter and half-on isolation states.
mathematical_formalization: enable_main = token_2 AND (V_store >= V_min) AND NOT chatter_flag.
analogical_connections: debounced state machine with analog commit
implementation_hypothesis: A pulse-latched token chain can replace always-on comparators in the earliest startup phase and prevent repeated half-enables.
experiment_seed: Stress slow ramps and UVLO threshold oscillation to quantify chatter reduction and added control energy.

closest_prior_art.title: A 220-mV Power-on-Reset Based Self-Starter With 2-nW Quiescent Power for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting Systems
A CMOS Startup Circuit for Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting Systems

novelty_claim: Useful as a shared sub-block even if it is not the headline concept, because UVLO chatter is a direct kill-risk for H1.
differentiation: Positioned as a control block inside the startup family rather than a standalone novelty claim.
predicted_failure_mode: The token chain becomes another hidden control rail and erases the energy advantage.
